parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO stark_leads (post_id, author, message, permalink, ai_comment, lead_score, score_reason)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.post_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.author || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.permalink || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.ai_comment || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.lead_score || 10 }},
  '{{ ($json.score_reason || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, post_id, author, message, permalink, ai_comment, lead_score, score_reason;
